changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Rename observation key typeOfHivTest -> typeOfHivTestDone on PMTCT-origin hts_encounter records to match HTS naming
changeSet.sql: UPDATE hts_encounter SET observation = (observation - 'typeOfHivTest') || jsonb_build_object('typeOfHivTestDone', observation->>'typeOfHivTest') WHERE pmtct_hts = true AND observation ?? 'typeOfHivTest' AND NOT (observation ?? 'typeOfHivTestDone');
